title: Randomized phase 3 study of intermittent or continuous Panitumumab plus FOLFIRI for first-line treatment of patients with unresectable left sided RAS/B-RAF wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer (IMPROVE-2 trial)
official: Randomized phase 3 study of intermittent or continuous Panitumumab plus FOLFIRI for first-line treatment of patients with unresectable left sided RAS/B-RAF wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer (IMPROVE-2 trial)
summary:
Main objective: To investigate whether experimental intermittent treatment of Panitumumab plus FOLFIRI (given until progression during treatment or inacceptable toxicity) results effective in first line as the same regimen given continuously, in the treatment of metastatic left sided RAS/B-RAF wild-type colorectal cancer patients.
To assess whether an improvement in safety, tolerability and quality of life can be achieved in the intermittent arm as compared to the continuous arm.
To explore potential biomarkers of primary and secondary resistance as well as to monitor treatment efficacy and toxicity on both tissue, primary tumors and resected metastases when available, and blood samples.
conditions: Unresectable left sided RAS/B-RAF wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer

interventions.name: Vectibix 20 mg/ml concentrate for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Written informed consent to study procedures and to correlative studies
2. Known dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPYD) activity is mandatory. Additional analysis of polymorphisms uridine diphosphate-glycosyltransferase 1  (UGT1A1) enzyme is recommended but not mandatory
3. Adequate bone marrow hematological function: absolute neutrophil count (ANC)  ≥ 1.5 x 109 /L AND platelet count ≥ 100 x 109 /L AND hemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL.
4. Adequate liver function: total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN) or ≤ 2  in case of biliary stent) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST)/alanine aminotransferase  (ALT) ≤ 5 X ULN
5. Adequate renal function: serum creatinine ≤ 1.5 mg/dL OR creatinine clearance ≥  60 mL/min in males and ≥50 mL/min in females (calculated according to Cockroft-Gault  formula)
6. Electrolytes (i.e. magnesium, calcium, sodium and potassium) within laboratory  normal range
7. Histologically proven left sided mCRC
8. RAS/BRAF wild-type and pMMR and/or MSS status assessed at local centers  according to a validated method defined by EMA
9. Disease judged unresectable by the local multidisciplinary team.
10. Patient candidate to receive Induction treatment with FOLFIRI plus panitumumab  as per standard clinical practice
11. No prior treatments (chemotherapy, radiation or surgery) for mCRC. Surgery for  primary CRC tumor before starting treatment is allowed
12. Either sex aged ≥ 18 years
13. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status ≤1 at study  entry
14. Imaging-documented measurable disease, according to RECIST 1.1 criteria
Exclusion criteria:
1. Prior malignancy within five years. Exceptions include basal cell carcinoma of the  skin or squamous cell carcinoma of the skin that has undergone potentially  curative therapy or in situ cervical cancer
2. Participation in any interventional drug or medical device study within 30 days  prior to treatment start
3. Sexually active males and females (of childbearing potential) unwilling to practice  contraception (barrier contraceptive measure or oral contraception) during the  study and until 6 months after the last trial treatment
4. History of interstitial pneumonitis or pulmonary fibrosis
5. History of corneal perforation or ulceration keratitis
6. Prior chemotherapy or any other medical treatment for mCRC (previous adjuvant  chemotherapy is allowed if terminated > 6 months previously)
7. Major surgical intervention within 4 weeks prior to enrollment
8. Pregnancy and breast-feeding
9. Any brain metastases
10. Complete deficiency of activity of dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPYD) or  known UGT1A1 homozygosity
11. Required dose reduction of 5-fluorouracil in the past for toxicity
12. Evidence of severe or uncontrolled systemic disease or any concurrent condition  which in the investigator’s opinion makes it undesirable for the patient to  participate in the study, or which would jeopardize compliance with the protocol,  or would interfere with the results of the study
13. History of poor co-operation, non-compliance with medical treatment,  unreliability or any condition that may impair the patient's understanding of the  Informed consent form
